answer: Amazon’s software detected that Fred Ruckel’s Ripple Rug was being sold somewhere else at a cheaper price, so Amazon removed it from the buy box [by_paragraph-56e6d2ea5c50543e11e1c290078615d41ba18897c9ab19b9878fecc1c3e6fa04]. This reflected Amazon’s practice of penalizing sellers when it detects a lower price elsewhere [by_paragraph-376becd4cd667c107b523bee124b6515a61c950e3201d5a54eefa55ae76de4dd].
